name: openclips
description: Make ad creative from your product catalogue with OpenClips: image ads, marketing videos and creator clips, through the OpenClips MCP server.

interface.longDescription: OpenClips turns your product catalogue into advertising creative: static image ads, marketing videos and creator-led clips, plus edits of creatives you already have. These skills teach the agent to drive the OpenClips MCP server well: pick the workspace, find the product, choose the right lane or model, preview the cost, and wait for an explicit go before spending credits. OpenClips produces the files; you publish them in your own ads manager.
defaultPrompt: Make an image ad for my newest product
Create a 15-second creator video for this product
Resize this creative to Stories format
